summary: Core Scientific, Inc., through its subsidiary Core Scientific Finance I LLC, filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a private offering of $3.3 billion in 7.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The notes were issued at 99.250% of par to qualified institutional buyers, yielding net proceeds of ~$3.24 billion after discounts and expenses. Proceeds will fund a debt service reserve account and then be distributed upstream to Core Scientific, which plans to repay its outstanding Bridge Facility delayed draw term loans. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the structure involves subsidiary guarantors and a collateral package. What to watch: successful repayment of bridge debt reduces near-term refinancing risk but adds significant leverage—monitor credit rating actions and Bitcoin mining economics for covenant headroom.
